key_insight: A linear, decoupled BDF2-type finite element integrator advances coupled magnetization and spin diffusion using two independent linear solves per time step.
engineering_relevance: The method supports parallel time-step solves for spintronics simulations of ferromagnetic multilayers.
method: Use projection-free BDF2-type tangent-plane discretization for magnetization.
Apply BDF2 time-stepping to spin accumulation.
Extrapolate coupling terms explicitly to decouple the linear solves.
evidence_signal: The paper proves unconditional weak convergence and bounds on unit-length constraint deviation, with numerical experiments supporting the theoretical findings.
watch_item: Magnetization length is not enforced exactly, and the limiting energy inequality requires additional assumptions on the energy functional.
paper_title: A decoupled BDF2-type integrator for the spin-diffusion Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert system in ferromagnetic multilayers
